name: stock-analyser
description: Lightweight TypeScript monorepo for stock market research (foundation only)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stock-analyser/shared && npm run build -w @stock-analyser/api -w @stock-analyser/web
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @stock-analyser/shared && npm run seed -w @stock-analyser/api
